summary: This directory centralizes the metadata definitions, filtering criteria, and transport configurations required for handling file system operations within the gyomu module, ensuring consistent representation of file-related data.
responsibilities: Define metadata for file system objects and operations
Specify filtering criteria and comparison logic for file selection
Configure path and transport settings for file data movement
relationships: File filtering criteria define how file metadata is evaluated during processing.
Transport configurations utilize file metadata to manage the movement and destination of file system entities.
designDecisions: Centralized type definitions for shared file operation constants
Separation of concerns between filter metadata and transport configuration models
